items.title: Verification Debt in Automated Biological Research Workflows: A Proof-of-Concept
items.title_zh: 自动化生物研究工作流中的验证债务：概念验证
items.summary_zh: 近期生物研究对采用代理式AI系统表现出显著兴趣和进展。具有访问大量生物工具集合且具备代码生成和/或查询能力的领域特定代理平台，如Biomni（示例性案例），代表了编排自动化研究工作流的能力。此类平台为生物学家和研究人员提供用于药物发现、基因组学、生物信息学、文献研究和实验规划的协作AI工作空间。当此类平台用于上述工作流时，由于涉及决策规模庞大，且假设和方法选择披露不足、证据可追溯性有限、以及整个工作流中嵌入的解释性判断，逐一验证每个代理决策及其达成的研究过程变得具有挑战性，从而产生验证债务。代理环境中的验证债务可能导致下游实验中的意外失败和后果。本研究聚焦于代理式（提示到结果）工作流中验证债务的实证定性表征。本研究选择Biomni作为测试AI代理平台，主要因其提供描述性轨迹以追踪每个代理步骤。验证债务通过两个互补角度考察：承载主张和证据的单个代理决策步骤，以及代理达成并报告这些步骤的底层研

extra.description: Recent biological research has shown significant interest and progress towards adoption of agentic AI systems. Domain specific agentic platforms with access to large collections of biological tools with code generation and/or querying capabilities, such as Biomni (illustrative case in point), are representative of the capability to orchestrate automated research workflows. Such platforms enable collaborative AI workspace for drug discovery, genomics, bioinformatics, literature research, and experimental planning for biologists and researchers. When such platforms are used for the aforementioned workflows, individually validating every agentic decision and the research process by which it was reached becomes challenging due to the scale of decisions involved and oftentimes, insufficient disclosure of assumptions and methodological choices, limited traceability of evidence, and interpretive judgments embedded throughout the workflow, giving rise to verification debt. Verification debt in agentic environments could result in unexpected failures and consequences in downstream experiments. This study focuses on empirical qualitative characterization of verification debt in agentic (prompt to outcomes) workflows. Biomni was chosen the testing AI agentic platform in this study mainly due to the descriptive traces it provides to track every agentic step. Verification debt is examined through two complementary angles: the individual agentic decision steps that carry claims and evidence, and the underlying research process by which the agent arrives at and reports them. This study attempts to characterize verification debt with 10 test cases (covering proteomics, genomics and drug discovery) with varying degree of biological nuance across three identical and independent runs. Verification debt is represented through 9 decision-step metrics and 13 research-process metrics, and also propose the VERIFY framework for evaluating scientific verifiability and validity in agentic workflows.

items.title: Decoupling Exploration from Optimization in RLVR
items.title_zh: 在RLVR中将探索与优化解耦
items.summary_zh: 现代语言模型在已训练检查点之上进行带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。RLVR的一个关键承诺是发现新的推理策略。原则上，模型可以采样其先前训练数据中不存在的新想法。然而在实践中，用强新颖性激励增强RLVR收效有限，且可能降低模型质量。因为可验证奖励仅监督模型知识和行为的狭窄部分，此类退化难以恢复。相反，我们在称为探索-蒸馏（ExpDis）的框架中将探索与优化解耦。我们训练一个或多个在奖励中带有新颖性奖励的探索者策略，过滤其轨迹的正确性和质量，并将其蒸馏到单独的学生策略中。学生策略随后在没有新颖性奖励的情况下训练。我们重复上述过程若干轮，交替进行探索和优化。这种解耦使我们能够积极扩展探索而不降低学生策略。在七个数学推理基准和两个模型家族上，ExpDis在相同墙钟预算下优于DAPO。此外，我们观察到改进的pass@$k$扩展，表明ExpDis产生能生成更多样正确解的模型。

extra.description: Modern language models undergo reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on top of already-trained checkpoints. A key promise of RLVR is the discovery of new reasoning strategies. In principle, a model can sample novel ideas absent from its prior training data. In practice, however, augmenting RLVR with strong novelty incentives has seen limited success and can degrade model quality. Because verifiable rewards supervise only a narrow slice of the model's knowledge and behavior, such degradations are difficult to recover from. Instead, we decouple exploration from optimization in a framework we call Exploration-Distillation (ExpDis). We train one or more explorer policies with a novelty bonus in the reward, filter their trajectories for correctness and quality, and distill them into a separate student policy. The student policy is then trained without a novelty bonus. We repeat the above procedure for several rounds, alternating between exploration and optimization. This decoupling allows us to aggressively scale exploration without degrading the student policy. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families, ExpDis outperforms DAPO at the same wall-clock budget. Moreover, we observe improved pass@$k$ scaling, indicating that ExpDis produces models that generate more diverse correct solutions.

items.title: Distilling Graph Geometry: Knowledge Gap from GNNs to MLPs
items.title_zh: 蒸馏图几何：从GNN到MLP的知识差距
items.summary_zh: GNN到MLP蒸馏旨在保留消息传递教师的预测准确性，同时在推理时部署无图MLP。现有方法主要迁移节点级预测或使用基于置信度的重加权，但未指定学生应在何处保留教师的图诱导几何。我们表明这一遗漏导致学生表示空间中的两种谱失效模式。在稀疏图上，学生遭受谱欠拟合，缺失集中在边界区域附近的高能教师方向。在稠密图上，学生遭受谱过拟合，保留教师通过聚合已坍缩的虚假方向。受能量加权师生对齐目标启发，我们提出图几何感知MLP（G^2MLP），一个由Ollivier-Ricci曲率引导的训练时蒸馏框架。曲率识别两种谱误差集中之处，并用于在预测级和表示级对齐之间分配监督。部署模型仍是标准MLP，推理时无需图访问。在节点分类基准上，G^2MLP持续优于无图蒸馏基线，在两种情形下减少师生秩差距，并无需架构更改即可迁移到Graph Transformer教师和链接预测。

extra.description: GNN-to-MLP distillation aims to retain the predictive accuracy of a message-passing teacher while deploying a graph-free MLP at inference. Existing methods mainly transfer node-wise predictions or use confidence-based reweighting, but they do not specify where the student should preserve the teacher's graph-induced geometry. We show that this omission leads to two spectral failure modes in the student's representation space. On sparse graphs, the student suffers from spectral underfit, missing high-energy teacher directions concentrated near boundary regions. On dense graphs, it suffers from spectral overfit, retaining spurious directions that the teacher has collapsed through aggregation. Motivated by an energy-weighted teacher-student alignment objective, we propose Graph Geometry-aware MLP (G^2MLP), a training-time distillation framework guided by Ollivier-Ricci curvature. Curvature identifies where the two spectral errors concentrate and is used to allocate supervision between prediction-level and representation-level alignment. The deployed model remains a standard MLP and requires no graph access at inference. Across node-classification benchmarks, G^2MLP consistently improves over graph-free distillation baselines, reduces the teacher-student rank gap in both regimes, and transfers without architectural changes to Graph Transformer teachers and link prediction.

items.title: SciExam for ENSO: Can AI Agents Build Climate Models?
items.title_zh: SciExam for ENSO：AI代理能构建气候模型吗？
items.summary_zh: 语言模型代理日益被要求开展开放式科学研究，然而其结果通常对照已知答案、评分标准或语言模型评审进行评分，这些都无法判断新科学模型是否有效。厄尔尼诺-南方涛动AI科学考试（SciExam for ENSO）是一个基准，其中代理从真实观测构建ENSO的低阶随机模型，ENSO是年际气候变率的主导模态。在六小时预算内，代理处理观测数据，编写自己的诊断，随后这些诊断被冻结，代理仅使用这些诊断作为反馈开发模型。隐藏评分器随后测试模型是否重现ENSO统计量、恢复未观测变量并预测留出年份，并以相同方式对已发表模型评分。在十二个代理系统中，六个产生的模型得分高于已发表模型，主要通过更好的重建和预测。较强模型的简化形式各自与ENSO冷暖不对称的两种竞争解释之一相容，这是一个任务从未提及的开放辩论。对顶级系统在不同信息下的受控运行表明，其得分并非来自回忆过时的观测记录，且其接收的信息塑造其构建模型的方式。因此，S

extra.description: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out open-ended scientific research, yet their results are usually graded against a known answer, a rubric, or a language-model reviewer, none of which can tell whether a new scientific model is valid. The AI Science Exam for El Nino-Southern Oscillation (SciExam for ENSO) is a benchmark in which agents build low-order stochastic models of ENSO, the dominant mode of interannual climate variability, from real observations. Within a six-hour budget, agents process the observations, write their own diagnostics, which are then frozen, and develop a model using only these diagnostics as feedback. Hidden graders then test whether the model reproduces ENSO's statistics, recovers unobserved variables, and forecasts held-out years, and score a published model in the same way. Across twelve agent systems, six produce models that score higher than the published model, mainly through better reconstruction and forecasting. The simplified forms of the stronger models are each compatible with one of the two competing explanations of ENSO's warm-cold asymmetry, an open debate that the task never mentions. Controlled runs of the top system under varied information suggest that its scores do not come from recalling the dated observational record and that the information it receives shapes how it builds its model. SciExam for ENSO can thus evaluate agent research where no answer is known, and the results suggest that agents can already build competitive models whose structures bear on questions that scientists still debate.

items.title: RECAST: Learning to Compute the Right Context through Adaptive Evidence Routing
items.title_zh: RECAST：通过自适应证据路由学习计算正确上下文
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型日益应用于基于长而异构信息源的任务。传统检索增强生成（RAG）依赖固定的基于相似度的检索，而代理式变体适应查询和工具使用，但仍以检索为中心。然而，在许多任务中，解决方案所需证据并不明确存在于任何单一源项中。相反，它必须通过跨多个源项的过滤、聚合或计算来推导。在本工作中，我们介绍RECAST（通过计算、访问和合成工具路由证据），一个学习框架，将证据构建表述为对异构检索和计算操作的顺序决策过程，允许证据被主动推导而非仅被检索。轻量级RouterLM迭代选择并制定原始操作，或为冻结的CompilerLM指定定制操作以翻译为可执行代码。一旦判断证据充分，RouterLM将接受的证据传递给冻结的AnswerLM以产生最终解决方案。我们用监督微调（SFT）随后组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练RouterLM。在六个异构基准家族上，RECAST达到75.6%的平均成功率，超过最强大型模型基线1

extra.description: Large language models are increasingly applied to tasks grounded in long, heterogeneous information sources. Conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) relies on fixed similarity-based retrieval, while agentic variants adapt queries and tool use but remain largely retrieval-centric. However, in many tasks, the evidence required for a solution is not explicitly present in any single source item. Instead, it must be derived through filtering, aggregation, or computation across multiple source items. In this work, we introduce RECAST (Routing Evidence through Computation, Access, and Synthesized Tools), a learned framework that formulates evidence construction as a sequential decision process over heterogeneous retrieval and computation operations, allowing evidence to be actively derived rather than merely retrieved. A lightweight RouterLM iteratively selects and formulates primitive operations or specifies customized operations for a frozen CompilerLM to translate into executable code. Once it judges the evidence sufficient, RouterLM passes the accepted evidence to a frozen AnswerLM to produce the final solution. We train RouterLM with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO). Across six heterogeneous benchmark families, RECAST achieves a mean success rate of 75.6%, outperforming the strongest large-model baseline by 15.9%. Moreover, training enables the Qwen3.5-9B RouterLM to outperform a training-free Gemini 3.5 Flash RouterLM by 5.0%. On three held-out benchmarks, RECAST improves over the strongest baseline by 15.0% on average, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization across tasks and heterogeneous source representations.

items.title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
items.title_zh: EmbodiedRSI：通过假设引导协同进化的主动持续机器人学习
items.summary_zh: 机器人基础模型提供强视觉运动控制，然而当物体位置或任务指令变化时其性能可能下降。进一步改进通常需要在大量机器人数据上后训练，而通过遥操作等方法收集这些数据可能成本高昂。代理式框架可围绕模型适应，但当前自进化框架在决定追求哪些代码和技能更改时低效使用机器人试验。我们介绍EmbodiedRSI，一个自进化代理式框架，自主决定下一步探索何处，并将由此产生的物理交互转化为改进的代码和技能。EmbodiedRSI通过快慢双系统架构实现这一点，其中竞争的代码和技能假设维护在假设图中。信息价值实验选择选择能区分这些假设的物理实验。其结果引导代码-技能协同进化。慢系统构建分层记忆，奖励接地记忆学习根据其对后续快系统改进的价值选择有效记忆。在RoboCasa365上，EmbodiedRSI达到77.0%总体成功率和71.3%的Composite-Unseen，而最佳基线为40.1%。EmbodiedRSI在

extra.description: Robot foundation models provide strong visuomotor control, yet their performance can degrade when object positions or task instructions change. Further improvements often require post-training on substantial robot data, which can be costly to collect through methods such as teleoperation. Agentic harnesses can adapt around the model, but current self-evolving harnesses use robot trials inefficiently when deciding which code and skill changes to pursue. We introduce EmbodiedRSI, a self-evolving agentic harness that autonomously decides where to explore next and turns the resulting physical interaction into improved code and skills. EmbodiedRSI realizes this through a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture, in which competing code and skill hypotheses are maintained in a Hypothesis Graph. Value-of-Information Experiment Selection chooses physical experiments that can distinguish these hypotheses. Their outcomes guide Code-Skill Co-Evolution. The Slow System builds Hierarchical Memory, and Reward-Grounded Memory Learning selects effective memory according to their value for later Fast-System improvement. On RoboCasa365, EmbodiedRSI reaches 77.0% overall success and 71.3% on Composite-Unseen, compared with 40.1% for the best baseline. EmbodiedRSI also reaches 86.8% overall success on LIBERO-Pro. Beyond benchmark performance, EmbodiedRSI transfers zero-shot to real-world robot, achieving 71.3% overall success across multiple challenging tasks.

items.title: Before They Can Solve: Predicting Post-Training Coding-Agent Performance from Base Models
items.title_zh: 在它们能解决之前：从基础模型预测后训练编码代理性能
items.summary_zh: 我们如何预测哪个基础检查点值得一轮昂贵的代理式后训练？端到端pass@$K$测试成功行为是否已出现在基础模型分布中，但它不适合代理式编码：许多基础检查点无法可靠产生端到端完成任务所需的格式良好的工具调用。单次或短时程任务通过将多步交互压缩为固定提示和单个补丁来避免这些工具调用失败，但它们回避了我们关心的核心能力：随着仓库演化，在许多使用工具的步骤中保持连贯状态。为弥合这一差距，我们将成功的后训练代理轨迹视为基础模型潜力的前瞻信号。重放每个轨迹并在每个更改代码的步骤后重新运行测试，识别决定性步骤：第一个其累积补丁将仓库从失败翻转为通过的步骤，证明记录的动作在先前上下文下解决了任务。受代理轨迹覆盖原则启发，我们在此步骤构建三个筛选器，不需要基础检查点从冷启动驱动框架：（i）决定性动作BPB（每字节比特）测量认证动作上的概率质量，（ii）补丁MCQ测试检查点在该动作与同一验证器拒绝的替代项之间的

extra.description: How can we predict which base checkpoint is worth an expensive round of agentic post-training? End-to-end pass@$K$ tests whether successful behavior already appears in a base model's distribution, but it is a poor fit for agentic coding: many base checkpoints cannot reliably produce the well-formed tool invocation required to complete a task end-to-end. Single-shot or short-horizon tasks avoid these tool-calling failures by collapsing a multi-step interaction into a fixed prompt and a single patch, but they sidestep the core capability we care about: maintaining coherent state over many tool-using steps as the repository evolves. To bridge this gap, we treat successful post-trained agent trajectories as a lookahead signal of base-model potential. Replaying each trajectory and rerunning tests after every code-changing step identifies the decisive step: the first step whose cumulative patch flips the repository from failing to passing, certifying that the recorded action solves the task given the prior context. Motivated by a coverage principle for agentic traces, we build three screens at this step that do not require a base checkpoint to drive the harness from a cold start: (i) Decisive-Action BPB (bits per byte) measures the probability mass on the certified action, (ii) Patch MCQ tests the checkpoint's choice between that action and alternatives rejected by the same verifier, and (iii) prefix-conditioned pass@$K$ evaluates support for functionally-correct generations and credits any continuation that the tests accept. Across ten pairs of public base and post-trained models, all three screens rank the cohort in close agreement with post-trained SWE-bench Verified pass@$1$. As our methods need only a benchmark's successful trajectories and its verifier, they can be applied to turn future agentic coding benchmarks into base-model evaluations.

items.title: Composing What Each Teacher Learned: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation through Teacher-Relative Shifts
items.title_zh: 组合每位教师所学：通过教师相对偏移的多教师在线策略蒸馏
items.summary_zh: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）用于两种设置。在共同域组合中，若干教师对来自一个提示域的每个学生 rollout 评分，其信号形成单一目标；在路由域蒸馏中，来自不同域的提示分配给相应专家。两种设置通常迁移每位教师的端点策略，该策略混合了后训练改变的内容与从教师基础继承的偏好。我们引入$Δ$-MOPD，它迁移每位教师的教师减基础logit偏移，并重新锚定在学生冻结初始化处，并在保持教师选择固定的情况下，在两种设置中与端点监督比较。我们首先揭示阻碍端点迁移的机制：继承的基础拉力可能超过后训练偏移。移除它降低教师项范数比和目标-学生KL。在我们的实验中，结果表明当教师信号在某一状态组合时，偏移目标特别有用。在三个组合教师下，$Δ$-MOPD超过端点组合4.11 Math和1.95五基准点；在两个教师下，它与端点准确率相当。在分阶段路由下，它在两种阶段顺序中均达到更高平均性能，并将观察到的顺序差距从

extra.description: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) is used in two settings. In common-domain composition, several teachers score each student rollout from one prompt domain and their signals form a single target; in routed-domain distillation, prompts from different domains are assigned to the corresponding specialist. Both settings usually transfer each teacher's endpoint policy, which mixes what post-training changed with preferences inherited from the teacher's base. We introduce $Δ$-MOPD, which transfers each teacher's teacher-minus-base logit shift re-anchored at the student's frozen initialization, and compare it with endpoint supervision in both settings while holding teacher selection fixed. We first expose the mechanism that impedes endpoint transfer: inherited base pull can exceed the post-training shift. Removing it reduces the teacher-term norm ratio and target--student KL. Across our experiments, the results suggest that shift targets are particularly useful when teacher signals are combined at a state. With three composed teachers, $Δ$-MOPD exceeds endpoint composition by $4.11$ Math and $1.95$ five-benchmark points; with two, it matches endpoint accuracy. Under phased routing, it achieves higher mean performance in both phase orders and reduces the observed order gap from $10.50$ to $6.42$ points. Under interleaved routing, where each update involves one teacher, the two targets perform comparably. The phased results provide supporting evidence that the benefit may extend to signals accumulated across training phases. Target construction is thus an independent design axis in MOPD, complementary to teacher selection.

items.title: PHRBench: A Behavioral Evaluation of Post-Hallucination Reasoning in LLMs
items.title_zh: PHRBench：LLM中幻觉后推理的行为评估
items.summary_zh: 幻觉信息可通过多阶段LLM系统传播，并成为后续推理上下文的一部分。现有关于幻觉后推理（PHR）的研究主要表征最终结果变化和聚合推理动态，对模型如何在响应级别解决幻觉前提理解不足。在本工作中，我们介绍PHRBench，一个跨四个域和18个大型语言模型的受控基准，用于行为结构化的PHR。PHRBench通过幻觉遵从、幻觉避免和启发式纠正独立于最终答案正确性表征每个推理轨迹，并定义有洞察力的轨迹为最终达到正确答案的成功纠正。在4820个受控实例中，我们发现成功恢复仍相对罕见，并与推理轨迹中更频繁的信念更新相关。我们进一步发现，幻觉提示的属性对成功恢复包含大量预测信号，轻量级预测器达到AUROC 0.847。这些发现提供幻觉后推理的行为视角，表征LLM如何解决错误上下文以及成功恢复何时可能发生。

extra.description: Hallucinated information can propagate through multi-stage LLM systems and become part of the context for subsequent reasoning. Existing studies of post-hallucination reasoning (PHR) mainly characterize changes in final outcomes and aggregate reasoning dynamics, leaving how models resolve hallucinated premises at the response level insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce PHRBench, a controlled benchmark for behaviorally structured PHR across four domains and 18 large language models. PHRBench characterizes each reasoning trajectory independently of final-answer correctness through Hallucination Compliance, Hallucination Avoidance, and Heuristic Correction, and defines an insightful trajectory as successful correction that ultimately reaches the correct answer. Across 4820 controlled instances, we find that successful recovery remains relatively rare and is associated with more frequent belief updates along the reasoning trajectory. We further find that properties of the hallucinated prompt contain substantial predictive signal for successful recovery, with a lightweight predictor achieving an AUROC of 0.847. These findings provide a behavioral view of post-hallucination reasoning, characterizing how LLMs resolve erroneous context and when successful recovery is likely to occur.

items.title: RunningTab: Direct Workspace Interaction with Environment-Side Tabs
items.title_zh: RunningTab：通过环境侧标签的直接工作空间交互
items.summary_zh: 许多知识工作从工作空间已持有的文件产生新交付物，LLM代理正开始接管此类工作。通过直接语料库交互，代理可从终端搜索和读取任何这些文件而无需索引，以这种方式从许多文件产生交付物即我们所说的直接工作空间交互（DWI）。然而，到达文件只是任务的一半：没有任何东西跟踪任务要求什么、已读取什么、以及已列出但从未打开什么，所有这些都从上下文窗口溜走而不留痕迹，因此代理可能提取一个数字却仍交付缺少它的报告。为解决此问题，我们提出RunningTab，一个为直接工作空间交互配备环境侧标签的框架：由环境与代理并排维护的每任务记录，记录任务仍欠什么。具体而言，代理添加其需求，而环境将每个读取的文件记录为带出处的摘录，将每个列出但未打开的文件记录为候选；代理随后可在其最佳匹配摘录和顶部未打开候选旁看到每个需求，根据匹配内容解决它或附理由搁置它，并且若它试图在需求仍开放时完成，则在完成检查中收到这些需求。我们在三

extra.description: Much knowledge work produces new deliverables from files a workspace already holds, and LLM agents are beginning to take such work over. Through direct corpus interaction, an agent can search and read any of those files from a terminal with no indexing, and producing a deliverable from many of them in this way is what we call direct workspace interaction (DWI). Reaching the files, however, is only half the task: nothing keeps track of what the task asks for, what has been read, and what was listed but never opened, all of which slip through the context window without leaving a trace, so an agent may extract a figure and still deliver a report without it. To address this, we present RunningTab, a framework that equips direct workspace interaction with an environment-side tab: a per-task record of what the task still owes, kept by the environment alongside the agent. Specifically, the agent adds its requirements, while the environment records every file read as an excerpt with its provenance and every listed but unopened file as a candidate; the agent can then see each requirement beside its best-matching excerpts and top unopened candidates, resolve it against matching content or set it aside with a reason, and, should it try to finish with requirements still open, receive them in a finish check. We validate RunningTab on three benchmarks with three LLMs, where it consistently outperforms plain DWI and baselines that keep the record in the model, while its tab usually holds the values a deliverable needs once seen.

items.title: Training Parallel Speculative Draft Models by Directly Minimizing Expected Decoding Rounds
items.title_zh: 通过直接最小化期望解码轮数训练并行推测草稿模型
items.summary_zh: 推测解码通过使用低成本草稿模型提出令牌，由全尺寸目标模型并行验证，从而加速大型语言模型推理。并行和半自回归（semi-AR）草稿器通过单次前向传递提出整个块来提高起草效率，但训练它们带来新困难：给定位置的草稿分布取决于解码轮从何处开始，而轮从何处开始取决于先前轮接受多少令牌。现有训练目标通常依赖块局部代理，忽略这种跨轮耦合，因此不直接优化全局解码效率。在本工作中，我们开发一个训练和评估这些草稿器的理论框架，将推测解码表示为马尔可夫奖励过程。该表述产生期望解码轮数（EDR）目标，它按状态占用加权局部拒绝成本，并恰好等于期望解码轮数。与先前代理目标不同，EDR不引入辅助超参数。我们随后推导精确时序差分梯度，支持从目标模型 rollout 进行无偏随机优化。同一框架还产生轮数的精确离线评估器，使得可在共享目标 rollout 上配对比较草稿器而无需运行推测解码。用EDR微调两个最先进草稿器DSp

extra.description: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a low-cost draft model to propose tokens that the full-size target model verifies in parallel. Parallel and semi-autoregressive (semi- AR) drafters improve drafting efficiency by proposing an entire block in a single forward pass, but training them raises a new difficulty: the draft distribution for a given position depends on where the decoding round starts, and where rounds start depends on how many tokens earlier rounds accepted. Existing training objectives typically rely on block-local surrogates that ignore this cross-round coupling, and therefore do not directly optimize the global decoding efficiency. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for training and evaluating these drafters by representing speculative decoding as a Markov reward process. This formulation yields the Expected Decoding Rounds (EDR) objective, which weights local rejection costs by state occupancies and exactly equals the expected number of decoding rounds. Unlike prior surrogate objectives, EDR introduces no auxiliary hyperparameters. We then derive an exact temporal-difference gradient that supports unbiased stochastic optimization from target-model rollouts. The same framework also yields an exact offline evaluator for round counts, enabling paired drafter comparisons on shared target rollouts without running speculative decoding. Finetuning two state-of-the- art drafters, DSpark and DFly, with EDR consistently improves mean accepted length and outperforms existing training objectives across nine benchmarks spanning math reasoning, code generation, and chat.

items.title: RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments
items.title_zh: RobotWorld：跨多样任务和具身基准测试机器人使用的多模态代理
items.summary_zh: 通用代理日益编写代码、使用工具并完成复杂数字任务，引发这些能力在多大程度上延伸到物理世界的问题。为研究此问题，我们介绍RobotWorld，一个用于机器人使用的挑战性模拟测试平台：通过机器人接口将指令和观测转化为物理任务执行。其84个任务涵盖操作、移动操作、运动、驾驶和空中控制，具有明确交互预算和可执行成功检查。通过分析任务结果与执行轨迹，我们识别出可迁移的能力和阻碍可靠完成的差距。此外，我们发现当前代理可构建复杂感知和控制工作流，包括图像分割、相机校准、空间估计和基于动力学的计算。然而，这些能力并不一致地组合为成功行为：代理尽管到达指令姿态却丢失任务相关物体状态，未能纠正无效动作，恢复过晚，或将未完成任务误认为完成。这种不均衡迁移也因模型而异：Astra在空间和受限接触目标上更常成功，而Opus 5.5在连续平衡和定时交互目标上更常成功。通过将这些结果与执行行为联系，RobotWorld

extra.description: General-purpose agents increasingly write code, use tools, and complete complex digital tasks, raising the question of how far these capabilities carry into the physical world. To investigate this, we introduce RobotWorld, a challenging simulation testbed for robot use: turning instructions and observations into physical task execution through robot interfaces. Its 84 tasks span manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, with explicit interaction budgets and executable success checks. By analysing task outcomes alongside execution traces, we identify both the capabilities that transfer and the gaps that prevent reliable completion. Furthermore, we find that current agents can construct sophisticated perception and control workflows, including image segmentation, camera calibration, spatial estimation, and dynamics-based computation. These capabilities, however, do not consistently compose into successful behaviour: agents lose task-relevant object states despite reaching commanded poses, fail to correct ineffective actions, recover too late, or mistake unfinished tasks for completion. This uneven transfer also differs across models: Astra succeeds more often on spatial and constrained-contact goals, whereas Opus 5.5 succeeds more often on continuous-balance and timed-interaction goals. By linking these outcomes to execution behaviour, RobotWorld provides both a rigorous proving ground and an empirical account of the remaining capability gaps, thereby establishing concrete targets for training and designing more reliable physical-world agents.

items.title: SOTA: Stock Options Trading Agents Guided by Option-Implied Return Distributions
items.title_zh: SOTA：由期权隐含收益分布引导的股票期权交易代理
items.summary_zh: 随着期权市场增长和AI进步，期权交易代理系统日益受到关注。基于语言模型的代理可对新闻等上下文信息进行推理，但期权交易呈现特别困难的决策问题：单只股票可有数千份合约，代理必须决定交易哪些合约以及如何组合它们。现有方法通常通过将策略限制为固定策略结构（如跨式）来回避这种复杂性，限制其随市场条件变化切换策略的能力。我们提出SOTA（股票期权交易代理），一个用于结构化期权策略选择的代理式交易框架。SOTA将庞大期权宇宙抽象为策略级决策，而确定性解析器处理投资组合实现。我们通过用监督微调随后强化学习后训练Qwen3.8-27B开发SOTA。SOTA在九只美国大盘股和SPY的期权上，在相同交易环境中对照基于规则和机器学习的策略选择器评估。在六个月样本外期间，SOTA获得18.3%总回报，夏普比率1.60，最大回撤8.96%。我们还记录新闻的不对称作用：新闻改善前沿教师轨迹，但在强化学习期间保留新闻使样

extra.description: As option markets grow and AI advances, agentic systems for option trading are gaining increasing attention. Language-model-based agents can reason over contextual information such as news, but option trading presents a particularly challenging decision problem: a single stock can have thousands of contracts, and the agent must decide both which contracts to trade and how to combine them. Existing approaches often sidestep this complexity by restricting the policy to a fixed strategy structure, such as a straddle, limiting their ability to switch strategies as market conditions change. We present SOTA (Stock Options Trading Agents), an agentic trading framework for structured option-strategy selection. SOTA abstracts the large option universe into strategy-level decisions while deterministic resolvers handle portfolio implementation. We develop SOTA by post-training Qwen3.8-27B with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. SOTA is evaluated on options on nine large-cap U.S. equities and SPY against rule-based and machine-learning strategy selectors in the same trading environment. Over a six-month out-of-sample period, SOTA earns an 18.3% total return with a Sharpe ratio of 1.60 and a maximum drawdown of 8.96%. We also document an asymmetric role of news: news improves frontier-teacher trajectories, but retaining news during reinforcement learning reduces out-of-sample return from 18.3% to -2.7%.

items.title: Executing Causal Structure Learning with Linear-Attention Transformers
items.title_zh: 用线性注意力Transformer执行因果结构学习
items.summary_zh: Transformer可在其输入中给出的数据上执行算法。我们问它们能否对因果发现做同样的事。我们研究一种标准连续方法，它反复更新候选因果图同时强制无环性。我们显式构造一个固定权重Transformer，其前向传递精确重现该方法的一次更新，因此重复块重现其优化轨迹。Transformer在更新之间携带当前图和算法的乘子。我们表明保留乘子对精确执行至关重要，因为不同乘子值可导致不同下一次更新。我们还给出条件，在此条件下，在固定阶段内，达到目标精度所需更新次数可提前计算，且随深度增长舍入误差保持有界。实验表明，构造的块与参考更新在浮点精度上一致，而在合成数据和七个已发表基准网络拓扑上的算术重放继承参考求解器的成功和失败。这将准确算法执行与准确因果恢复分开。相比之下，在我们训练预算下测试的普通注意力模型不能可靠执行更新或迁移到更大图。梯度训练能否在构造的架构类中学习执行器仍开放。

extra.description: Transformers can execute algorithms on data given in their input. We ask whether they can do the same for causal discovery. We study a standard continuous method that repeatedly updates a candidate causal graph while enforcing acyclicity. We explicitly construct a fixed-weight transformer whose forward pass exactly reproduces one update of this method, so repeated blocks reproduce its optimization trajectory. The transformer carries the current graph and the algorithm's multiplier between updates. We show that retaining the multiplier is essential for exact execution, since different multiplier values can lead to different next updates. We also give conditions under which, within a fixed stage, the number of updates needed to reach a target accuracy can be computed in advance and rounding errors stay bounded as depth grows. Experiments show that the constructed block agrees with a reference update to floating-point precision, while arithmetic replay on synthetic data and seven published benchmark network topologies inherits the reference solver's successes and failures. This separates accurate algorithm execution from accurate causal recovery. In contrast, the ordinary attention models tested under our training budgets do not reliably execute the update or transfer to larger graphs. Whether gradient training can learn an executor in the architecture class of the construction remains open.

items.title: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test
items.title_zh: RoboQuest：搜索、检查和测试的通用物理代理
items.summary_zh: 多模态基础模型的最新进展使其成为一系列操作任务的能干通用物理代理。然而，在不熟悉环境中成功操作可能要求代理在观测中缺失任务相关信息时通过交互寻求信息：它可能需要确定相关物体在哪里、检查未观测属性、或发现不熟悉工具的效果。因此我们介绍RoboQuest，一个目标导向具身探索基准，其中代理必须通过物理交互主动获取任务相关信息，使用所得证据适应后续动作，并自主决定何时承诺完成任务。RoboQuest包含十个移动操作任务，围绕三种不确定性形式：搜索、基于操作的检查和交互测试。我们通过共同视觉运动接口评估五个前沿多模态代理，以及在我们发布的全情节演示上微调的$π_{0.5}$策略。最佳代理仅在23%的情节中成功，而微调策略几乎从不成功。对任务所构建执行技能的孤立测试，在提供隐藏信息的情况下，显示代理可执行大多数所需动作，我们的失败分析仅将少数失败归因于执行。我们的失败分析进一步发现，代理常过早停止探

extra.description: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a $π_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23\% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.

items.title: Pervasive Backdoor Vulnerabilities in Genomic Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 基因组基础模型中普遍存在的后门漏洞
items.summary_zh: 基因组基础模型正在革新生物学研究和生物技术，然而其对数据投毒的脆弱性仍鲜有刻画。在此我们表明，仅需用短DNA基序（包括源自转座子末端反向重复序列（TIR）的触发序列）毒化一小部分训练数据，后门攻击就能在微调期间可靠地植入到不同模型架构、任务和模型规模中。基于编码器和自回归模型的攻击成功率普遍较高，而干净任务性能几乎不变。增加模型规模并未带来可测量的抵抗力。为检测此类威胁，我们开发了一个两阶段审计框架，通过模型预测中局部单核苷酸突变敏感性来标记可能被毒化的序列，无需事先知道触发序列。这些结果将下游微调确定为基因组基础模型的攻击面，并推动更强的数据溯源、对抗评估和训练后安全审计。

extra.description: Genomic foundation models are revolutionizing biological research and biotechnology, yet their vulnerability to data poisoning remains poorly characterized. Here we show that backdoor attacks can be reliably implanted during fine-tuning across diverse model architectures, tasks and model scales by poisoning only a small fraction of training data with short DNA motifs, including triggers derived from transposon terminal inverted repeats (TIRs). Attack success rates are generally high across encoder-based and autoregressive models, while clean-task performance remains almost unchanged. Increasing model scale does not confer measurable resistance. To detect such threats, we develop a two-stage auditing framework that flags potentially poisoned sequences through localized single-nucleotide mutation sensitivity in model predictions, without prior knowledge of trigger sequences. These results identify downstream fine-tuning as an attack surface for genomic foundation models and motivate stronger data provenance, adversarial evaluation and post-training security auditing.

items.title: EndoMT: An R Package Resource for Endothelial-Mesenchymal Transition Gene Set Enrichment Analysis
items.title_zh: EndoMT：一个用于内皮-间充质转化基因集富集分析的R包资源
items.summary_zh: 引言：内皮-间充质转化（EndoMT）是一种动态内皮细胞状态转变，日益被认为与纤维化、血管功能障碍、炎症和癌症有关。尽管EndoMT聚焦的转录组研究扩展，但在标准基因集库中EndoMT表示仍局限于更广泛的上皮-间充质转化（EMT）框架。方法：为解决转录组富集分析缺乏通用EndoMT基因集的问题，我们开发了一个开放EndoMT基因集资源及配套R包。我们整理了一个基于文献的EndoMT基因集，并根据部分EndoMT期间报道或假设的表达，将其方向性分配给EndoMT UP和EndoMT DOWN特征，此处部分EndoMT定义为活跃过渡状态而非完全间充质终点，以改善捕获该过程不同阶段EndoMT相关转录变化。基因按标记亚型注释，并实现为通过R包分发的Gene Matrix Transposed文件，连同导出的R对象和基因级元数据。使用bulk RNA-seq数据集GSE118446（包含七天IL-

extra.description: Introduction: Endothelial-mesenchymal transition (EndoMT) is a dynamic endothelial cell-state transition increasingly implicated in fibrosis, vascular dysfunction, inflammation and cancer. Despite expansion of EndoMT-focused transcriptomic research, EndoMT representation remains limited to broader epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) frameworks in standard gene set repositories. Methods: To address the absence of a general-purpose EndoMT gene set for transcriptomic enrichment analysis, we developed an open EndoMT gene set resource and accompanying R package. A literature-informed EndoMT gene set was curated and directionally assigned to EndoMT UP and EndoMT DOWN signatures according to reported or hypothesised expression during partial EndoMT, defined here as an active transitional state rather than a complete mesenchymal endpoint, to improve capture of EndoMT-associated transcriptional changes across different stages of the process. Genes were annotated by marker subtype and implemented as Gene Matrix Transposed files distributed through the R package, together with exported R objects and gene-level metadata. Benchmarking was performed using bulk RNA-seq data sets GSE118446, comprising seven-day IL-1l{beta}/TGF-{beta}2-treated human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) and human pulmonary arterial endothelial cells, and GSE342578, comprising three-day TGF-{beta}1/2/3-treated HUVECs; single-cell RNA-seq data set GSE237895, comprising seven-day TGF-{beta}1-treated and SNAI1-overexpressing HUVECs; and endothelial cell and cancer-associated fibroblast populations from human metastatic melanoma single-cell RNA-seq data set GSE72056. Results: In GSE118446, EndoMT UP was positively enriched and EndoMT DOWN negatively enriched in chronically IL-1{beta}/TGF-{beta}2-treated endothelial cells, concordant with experimentally validated EndoMT induction, while partial EndoMT-associated enrichment was detected in single ligand-treatment. In contrast, EndoMT UP was negatively enriched following acute TGF-{beta}1/2/3 treatment, suggesting temporal differences between acute TGF-{beta} stimulation and chronic EndoMT induction. In GSE237895 mesenchymal-like endothelial cells, EndoMT UP was positively enriched and EndoMT DOWN negatively enriched in both TGF-{beta}1-treated and SNAI1-overexpressing models. EndoMT gene sets also discriminated endothelial and mesenchymal/stromal transcriptional states in GSE72056 metastatic melanoma. Marker subtype and Gene Ontology Biological Process analyses provided additional exploratory resolution of EndoMT-associated components beyond MSigDB Hallmark EMT. Discussion: The EndoMT R package provides a dedicated, accessible and interoperable resource for EndoMT-focused transcriptomic enrichment analysis. Benchmarking demonstrates utility for detecting established, partial and divergent EndoMT-associated states, supporting broad applicability across EndoMT biology research.

items.title: PhyloZoo: a unified framework for phylogenetic network analysis in Python
items.title_zh: PhyloZoo：一个用于Python中系统发育网络分析的统一框架
items.summary_zh: 网状进化过程（谱系合并的事件，如杂交、重组和水平基因转移）在自然界广泛存在，但仅靠系统发育树无法表示。因此系统发育网络已成为重要建模工具，然而现有软件通常绑定特定推断范式，并对在统一可编程环境中处理多种网络表示提供有限支持。PhyloZoo是一个开源Python框架，降低开发实用、易用的系统发育网络分析软件的门槛。它提供覆盖该领域主要表示的数据结构和算法，连同专用可视化工具和所有主要系统发育文件格式的稳健I/O。特别强调半定向系统发育网络，它明确表示根不确定性，而现有软件对此支持有限。通过提供开发可互操作工具的共享、可扩展基础，以及支持计算证明和理论探索的组合层，PhyloZoo为网状进化的应用、方法和理论研究提供可复现工作流。可用性与实现：PhyloZoo用Python实现，可从PyPI安装，源代码、文档和示例见https://github.com/nholtgrefe/phylozoo

extra.description: Reticulate evolutionary processes (events in which lineages merge, such as hybridization, recombination, and horizontal gene transfer) are widespread across nature but cannot be represented by phylogenetic trees alone. Phylogenetic networks have therefore become an important modelling tool, yet existing software is typically tied to specific inference paradigms and provides limited support for working with multiple network representations in a unified and programmable environment. PhyloZoo is an open-source Python framework that lowers the barrier to developing practical, easy-to-use software for phylogenetic network analysis. It provides data structures and algorithms covering the main representations used in the field, together with dedicated visualization tools and robust I/O for all major phylogenetic file formats. A particular emphasis lies on semi-directed phylogenetic networks, which explicitly represent root uncertainty and have so far received limited support in existing software. By offering a shared, scalable foundation for developing interoperable tools and a combinatorial layer that supports computational proofs and theoretical exploration, PhyloZoo enables reproducible workflows for applied, methodological, and theoretical studies of reticulate evolution. Availability and implementation: PhyloZoo is implemented in Python and installable from PyPI, with source code, documentation, and examples available at https://github.com/nholtgrefe/phylozoo.

items.title: Extreme conservation and rare evolutionary deviations in mammalian NOTCH3 inform the interpretation of CADASIL pathogenicity
items.title_zh: 哺乳动物NOTCH3的极端保守性和罕见进化偏离为CADASIL致病性解读提供信息
items.summary_zh: 背景/目标：NOTCH3是一种高度保守的跨膜受体，其致病性变异导致CADASIL，一种以血管平滑肌细胞变性和细胞外NOTCH3积累为特征的遗传性脑小血管病。大多数已确定的CADASIL变异改变细胞外EGF样重复序列中的半胱氨酸残基，但残基位置、二硫键连接、周围序列和结构域背景对NOTCH3结构和致病性的影响仍不完全清楚。我们使用比较哺乳动物分析来识别保守NOTCH3区域内的罕见变化，并评估它们与疾病相关分子机制的潜在相关性。方法：使用多序列比对以及互补的结构建模、内在无序预测、稳定性、聚集倾向、溶剂可及性和分子动力学分析，分析了来自113个哺乳动物物种的NOTCH3蛋白序列。结果：NOTCH3显示出异常的总体保守性，包括几乎所有被检测物种中全部204个细胞外半胱氨酸位置。识别出三种罕见的序列配置：美洲豹EGFr13,14,15中的七个半胱氨酸替换和一个半胱氨酸缺失；布兰特蝙蝠中的NRR缺失

extra.description: Background/Objectives: NOTCH3 is a highly conserved transmembrane receptor whose pathogenic variants cause CADASIL, a hereditary cerebral small vessel disease characterized by vascular smooth muscle cell degeneration and extracellular NOTCH3 accumulation. Most established CADASIL variants alter cysteine residues within the extracellular EGF like repeats, but the influence of residue position, disulfide connectivity, surrounding sequence, and domain context on NOTCH3 structure and pathogenicity remains incompletely understood. We used comparative mammalian analysis to identify rare changes within conserved NOTCH3 regions and evaluate their potential relevance to disease associated molecular mechanisms. Methods: NOTCH3 protein sequences from 113 mammalian species were ana-lysed using multiple sequence alignment together with complementary structural modelling, intrinsic disorder prediction, stability, aggregation propensity, solvent-accessibility, and molecular dynamics analyses. Results: NOTCH3 showed exceptional overall conservation, including all 204 extracellular cysteine positions across nearly all species examined. Three rare sequence configurations were identified: seven cysteine substitutions and one cysteine deletion in jaguar EGFr13,14,15; an NRR deletion in Brandt bat predicted to increase S2 cleavage-site accessibility; and an exon 16 associated X1 deletion affecting EGFr20,22, previously reported in a human CADASIL pedigree and also found in selected mammals. Computational analyses predicted distinct structural consequences, including disruption of the ca-nonical disulfide framework and increased intrinsic disorder across the affected jaguar EGFr13,14,15 region, increased S2 cleavage-site accessibility in Brandt bat, and a potential compensatory disulfide rearrangement with increased aggregation propensity in the X1 deletion isoform. Conclusions: These findings provide a comparative molecular pathology framework for interpreting NOTCH3 variation beyond cysteine number alone. They support a context dependent model in which residue position, disulfide architecture, surrounding sequence, domain organization, aggregation propensity, and proteolytic regulation jointly influence the predicted structural and functional consequences of NOTCH3 variants. The identified variants provide naturally occurring, experimentally testable models for investigating NOTCH3 folding, aggregation, receptor activation, and CADASIL associated pathogenicity.

items.title: PowerFit: An updated framework for fast rigid-body fitting into cryo-EM density maps.
items.title_zh: PowerFit：用于快速刚体拟合到冷冻电镜密度图的更新框架。
items.summary_zh: 冷冻电镜已成为确定分子组装结构的核心方法，需要可靠的工具来解读密度图。尽管AI驱动的模型构建最近取得了进展，但在中低分辨率（4-15 Å）下，将现有原子结构准确刚体拟合到冷冻电镜图中仍然是建模过程中的关键步骤。在这里，我们展示我们的软件包PowerFit的更新版本。它对冷冻电镜密度图执行穷举的平移和旋转搜索，实现灵敏的相关函数。更新版本保留了原始方法的拟合准确性和灵敏度，同时通过现代化的CPU和GPU实现大幅提高了计算性能。此外，为了便于解读结果，它提供带有使用MolViewSpec进行交互式3D可视化的HTML报告。通过其网络服务使用PowerFit时，也使用同一HTML报告生成结果页面。该报告能够立即检查和验证结果。该软件的可及性已通过从Python 2更新到Python 3得到增强，可通过Python包索引（PyPI）直接安装，并简单集成到计算流程中。PowerFit可在https:

extra.description: Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become a central method for determining structures of molecular assemblies, requiring reliable tools to interpret the density maps. Despite recent advances in AI-driven model building, at intermediate-to-low resolution (4-15 [a]) accurate rigid-body fitting of existing atomic structures into cryo-EM maps remains an essential step in the modelling process. Here we present an updated version of our software package PowerFit. It performs an exhaustive translational and rotational search against the cryo-EM density map, implementing sensitive correlation functions. The updated release preserves the fitting accuracy and sensitivity of the original method while substantially improving the computational performance through modernised CPU and GPU implementations. In addition, to facilitate the interpretation of results, it provides an HTML report with interactive 3D visualisation using MolViewSpec. The same HTML report is used to generate the result page when using PowerFit via its web service. The report enables immediate inspection and validation of the results. The software's accessibility has been enhanced by updating it from Python 2 to Python 3, enabling straightforward installation via the Python Package Index (PyPI) and simple integration into computational pipelines. PowerFit is freely available at https://github.com/haddocking/powerfit, as a web service at https://wenmr.science.uu.nl/powerfit or in JupyterLite directly in a web browser at https://www.bonvinlab.org/powerfit/jupyterlite.html.

items.summary_zh: 女友身体不好，要经常去医院，偏偏热门号源紧张，挂号屡屡落空。 为此，程序员男友周铭（化名）编写了一款“抢号软件”，帮其抢号。10月6日，记者从知情律师处获悉，两人因破坏计算机信息系统罪双双获刑。 周铭从计算机专业毕业后，在武汉某企业担任程序员。女友王琳（化名）因为身体不好，常年到医院看各种专家门诊。 由于看病的人众多，专家号难抢，往往放出号的同时就“秒无”。为帮助女友挂号，周铭很快写出一个抢号小程序。 律师透露，所谓抢号小程序，其实就是模仿人手按动鼠标点抢号按键，但人手一秒钟最快也就点六七下，而这个小程序一秒能点1000多下，总能抢到。 凭着这个抢号小程序，王琳挂专家号的问题解决了。但由于她总去看病，有熟人向她打听号是怎么挂上的。 起初，王琳出于好心，和周铭一商量，免费帮几个熟人抢了专家号。随着求助的人越来越多，他们开始帮人收费“抢号”。之后王琳招揽客源、对接客户，周铭则操作软件抢号、加价

items.title: 吴奇隆被曝因国庆手举国旗遭台机构取消活动，本人晒游览天坛视频，称不赚钱也是这个立场，怎样看待他的做法？
items.title_zh: 吴奇隆被曝因国庆手举国旗遭台机构取消活动，本人晒游览天坛视频，称不赚钱也是这个立场，怎样看待他的做法？
items.summary_zh: 近日，演员吴奇隆被曝因国庆期间手举国旗遭台湾相关机构取消活动。 10月1日，吴奇隆时隔33年重回天安门广场，手持五星红旗录制国庆祝福视频，还晒出小虎队早年在此的合影，追忆岁月、献礼祖国，真挚朴素的画面打动无数网友。 视频发布次日，台湾一棒球俱乐部紧急发文，取消吴奇隆原定10月4日的棒球赛事开球活动，称其“个人身体不适”。 10月4日，吴奇隆晒出登顶长城的动态，镜头中他步履轻快、状态松弛，悠然伫立长城之上，以山河为证，做出最霸气的无声回应。 10月6日，吴奇隆又发布最新视频，视频中他游览北京天坛，并且在视频最后表示以前这边游客没这么多，现在物质生活满足了，旅游的人也增多了，再加上来自世界各地的朋友都希望能够有机会认识我们国家，所以现在来的游客非常多，太了不起了！ 值得一提的是，在评论区，有网友留言说“想来赚钱就好好的坚持住这个立场”，吴奇隆回复：不赚钱也是这个立场。

items.title: 德印韩等 7 国有意申办 2036 奥运会，谁的胜算更大？各自有哪些优劣势？
items.title_zh: 德印韩等 7 国有意申办 2036 奥运会，谁的胜算更大？各自有哪些优劣势？
items.summary_zh: 国际奥委会10月6日表示，截至目前，德国、匈牙利、印度、卡塔尔、韩国、南非和土耳其七国明确表达了申办2036年奥运会的意愿。2036年奥运会举办权之争正逐渐升温，最终结果将于2029年年中揭晓。 国际奥委会公布了2036年奥运会举办地的遴选时间表，今年10月31日之后，将不再考虑其他2036年奥运会的申办方。下月，七国将向未来奥运会举办地委员会进行线上陈述。2027年3月，国际奥委会将完成可行性评估；同月，执委会将筛选出部分申办方，并从“持续对话”阶段推进至“战略对话”阶段。战略对话期间，国际奥委会将提供更为具体的支持与指导，未来奥运会举办地委员会还将赴实地考察，并向执委会提交报告。印度、韩国等七国有意申办2036年奥运会

items.title: 国足在邀请赛中三连败，邵佳一称仍会坚持大胆练兵，现阶段该优先锻炼新人还是追求比赛结果？
items.title_zh: 国足在邀请赛中三连败，邵佳一称仍会坚持大胆练兵，现阶段该优先锻炼新人还是追求比赛结果？
items.summary_zh: 10月6日，重庆国际足球邀请赛收官战，0比1不敌塔吉克斯坦队，中国男足遭遇三连败！此前0比3不敌新西兰、0比5负于巴勒斯坦，以三连败结束本次赛事。 赛后新闻发布会上，国足主帅邵佳一全程声音低沉，向球迷致歉。 邵佳一首先表示，球队未能在国庆假期为球迷带来胜利与快乐，坦言三连败的结果令人沮丧。但他强调，本次练兵并非全无收获，球队在阵容调配、球员使用和战术磨合上积累了经验，成长本就需要试错的过程。 针对外界对于大批新人表现不佳的质疑，邵佳一公开为年轻队员撑腰。他表示，赵松源、布尼亚明等小将都已在联赛证明过自己，能够登上国足赛场已是巨大突破。年轻球员成长总要经历苦涩过程，自己18岁时的状态尚且不及这批队员。教练组对新人的成长与整体表现感到满意，后续仍会坚持大胆练兵。

items.title: 韩国考虑废除「金牌免兵役」制度，如果真的废除将对韩国职业足球、体育行业带来哪些影响？
items.title_zh: 韩国考虑废除「金牌免兵役」制度，如果真的废除将对韩国职业足球、体育行业带来哪些影响？
items.summary_zh: 韩国部分亚运会金牌得主发表“免兵役比金牌重要”的不当言论后，韩国国防部6日表示，正在考虑收紧甚至废除针对运动员和艺术界人士的兵役豁免制度。 在3日举行的爱知·名古屋亚运会男子足球决赛中，韩国队1比0击败日本队，夺得金牌。根据韩国相关规定，23名队员中有20人获得兵役豁免资格，即以基础军事训练和社区服务替代服兵役。部分队员获胜后接受媒体采访时表示，与金牌或奖杯相比，他们更关注能否免兵役，引发韩国公众强烈不满和对兵役豁免制度公平性的争议。

items.title: 全球纯燃油车销量占比首次跌破 50%，将对全球汽车产业链格局带来哪些影响？
items.title_zh: 全球纯燃油车销量占比首次跌破 50%，将对全球汽车产业链格局带来哪些影响？
items.summary_zh: 10月6日消息，据多家外媒报道，Mobility Global最新数据显示，2026年上半年，纯汽油车型占全球新车销量的49%，这是历史上纯汽油车销量占比首次跌破五成，且较2021年的73%大幅下降了24个百分点。 Mobility Global是一家汽车数据机构，前身为标普全球汽车（S&P Global Mobility），今年从标普全球集团分拆独立。该机构数据显示，今年上半年，纯汽油车销量同比下降10%，至2025万辆。仅一年之内，其市场份额就下滑3个百分点，从52%降至49%。 数据还显示，今年上半年，整体汽车市场规模收缩约5%，而纯汽油车销量的下滑幅度达到了大盘的两倍。 业内人士将市场加速转变归因于油价。即受中东冲突影响，燃油价格大幅飙升，消费者开始寻求用车成本更低的车型。 分地域来看，上半年中国汽油车销量同比下降26%，为全球最大降幅；欧洲紧随其后，下滑了13%。纯电动车销量方面

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 5 日消息，苹果即将对 MacBook Pro 进行一次重大重塑，新机大约会在一个月之内正式亮相。这将是首款支持触控屏的 MacBook，同时也是首次采用叠层 OLED（Tandem OLED）屏幕的机型。除此之外，据彭博社的马克 · 古尔曼（Mark Gurman）在最新一期《Power On》中透露，新款 MacBook 相比上一代机型，重量还将会出现“显著”下降。 古尔曼再次提到，新款 MacBook Pro 预计“在下个月之前”发布，也就是说新机有望在 11 月底之前正式和大家见面。新机依旧搭载现有的 M5 Pro 以及 M5 Max 芯片；苹果选择跳过 M6 系列的高端版本，以此加快 M7 芯片的推出进度。 尽管关于这批 MacBook 的传闻已经流传许久，但此前外界大多只了解纸面规格信息：OLED 屏幕、触控功能、灵动岛等等。过去的报道只是说机身会做得更薄，

items.title_zh: 新华社痛批男足 0 比 5 惨败巴勒斯坦「亵渎国脚身份」，暴露出国足哪些深层问题？
items.summary_zh: 据新华社消息，2日，在重庆举行的国际足球邀请赛中，中国男足0:5惨败于巴勒斯坦队。终场哨响，比分牌上的数字冰冷而刺眼。 ▲新华社记者 陈诚 摄 这是一场令人震惊的失利。赛前，中国队世界排名第91位，巴勒斯坦队位列第95位。历史上双方交手7次，国足5胜2平，保持不败。 坐镇主场，面对实力并不算突出的对手，却遭遇如此大比分失利，显然让球迷难以接受。这也是国足历史上第四大比分的失利。 的确，这场比赛有着特殊背景：由于与亚运会赛程重合，国足很大一部分主力被抽调参加亚运会，加之塞尔吉尼奥、林良铭等球员因伤缺阵，成年国家队只能以一套大打折扣的阵容出战。本场首发阵容与今年6月人员相对齐整的热身赛相比，仅有两三个人重合。 反观巴勒斯坦方面，虽然同为亚洲国家，却没有派队参加本届亚运会足球项目的比赛，而对于本次在重庆举行的国际足球邀请赛，除一名主力球员外，巴勒斯坦队几乎是齐整队伍。 人员短缺之下，主教练邵佳一

items.title: 河北电商据称把成本压到极致，发1万单倒赔130，利润来自「卖纸壳」，是真的吗？河北电商是怎样一个存在？
items.title_zh: 河北电商据称把成本压到极致，发1万单倒赔130，利润来自「卖纸壳」，是真的吗？河北电商是怎样一个存在？
items.summary_zh: 中国低价的商品在哪里？ 三年前的答案是义乌，而如今，答案却变成了河北。 电商平台上的军大衣可以到50元以下，而卖家多半来自河北。同样一个小熊毛绒挂件，河北卖家的价格是义乌的一半左右。 “河北电商卷王”受到了越来越多的关注，这种价格内卷已经不是“薄利多销”，而是“无利多销”，主打一个分文不赚单量上万。 为什么河北电商之前相对来说默默无闻，而最近两年突然开始崭露头角呢？河北，正在打一场惨烈的价格战
